$ kubectl get pods -n shop

$ kubectl set env deploy/orders -n shop --from=configmap/orders-config
--- exit 1 (NOT_FOUND)
--- stdout
--- stderr

$ kubectl create configmap orders-config -n shop --from-literal=mode=prod

--- stdout

--- stderr

$ kubectl get pods -n shop
--- exit 0

orders-vqtcsddx9v-q7rwf   1/1     Running   5          10m
--- stderr
